content.text:
This is already a well-built, polished component (accessible pause/speed controls, reduced-motion handling, localStorage sync across tabs, etc.) — I didn't find obvious bugs. Rather than making arbitrary changes, what direction did you want to improve it in?

- **Visual/design**: different color theme, size options, more animation styles
- **Features**: e.g. keyboard arrow-key speed control, more speed presets, click-and-drag color customization
- **Accessibility**: anything specific you've noticed falling short
- **Code quality**: refactoring/splitting into separate CSS/JS files
- **Performance**: reducing blur/filter cost on low-end devices

Let me know which angle matters most and I'll dig in.
